name: OpenAlex
tagline: Open scholarly graph of works, authors, institutions, and citations
description: OpenAlex is a free, open scholarly metadata graph covering works, authors, institutions, sources, concepts, and citations. It provides a REST API for searching and retrieving bibliographic and research-output data at scale, suitable for discovery, bibliometrics, and research analytics.

auth.details: No key required for basic use; optional polite-pool email via mailto query param or From header improves rate limits

example.response_snippet: {"id":"https://openalex.org/W2741809807","doi":"https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj.4375","title":"The state of OA: a large-scale analysis of the prevalence and impact of Open Access articles","publication_year":2018}

use_cases: search scholarly works by title or DOI
look up an author's publications and citation counts
resolve institution metadata from OpenAlex IDs
fetch citation and reference graphs for a paper
